summary.text: Paula Swift is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 70 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Tri Ta.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a consultant and adjunct professor with a doctorate from the University of Southern California.

paragraphs.text: Paula Swift was born in California and graduated from Lynwood High School, then earned a bachelor's degree from Azusa Pacific University and graduate degrees, including an Ed.D., from the University of Southern California.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked for over twenty years across nonprofits, government and the private sector, runs a consulting firm and is an adjunct professor.
She also said she spent more than two decades advocating for foster youth and domestic violence survivors.
Swift advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, she said she would work on the cost of living, fair healthcare and stability for workers.
